verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs say contact lists can be imported, updated and organized programmatically, which covers the create/update half of the story for lists. Segment creation is documented only as a marketing-platform feature, with no evidence of an API for it. Nothing in the pack shows reading back list or segment membership via the API. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating and updating segments or tags, an API to read back exact list or segment membership, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
